announcement.text: Send your room size on WhatsApp for a price

hero.text: Sofa sets, beds, wardrobes, dining tables and desks, built to order in {city}. Pick a design from the shop or send us your room size, and we reply on WhatsApp with a price.

promo.label: Custom orders
promo.headline: Built to
promo.text: Send your room size and a photo of what you like. We reply with a price and a timeline.

footer.about: We build furniture to order for homes, shops and offices in {city}. Send your size and we reply with a price.

faqs.q: Can you make furniture to my size?
faqs.a: Yes. Beds, wardrobes, sofas, tables and desks are all built to the measurements you send, so the piece fits the space.

faqs.q: How do I get a price?
faqs.a: Message us on WhatsApp ({phone}) with a photo, your measurements or just an idea. We reply with a price and a timeline.

faqs.q: Can I choose the finish and colour?
faqs.a: Yes. Pick a wood tone or colour, or send a photo of a finish you like. We match it as closely as we can.

faqs.q: What is the price of a sofa set, bed or wardrobe?
faqs.a: Prices on this site start at {from}. The final figure depends on size, wood or board, fabric and finish. {examples} Send your size and we confirm the exact price before work begins.

faqs.q: Can you make a full bed set?
faqs.a: Yes. We can build a bed with storage, a dressing table and side tables in the same finish. Tell us which pieces you want and your mattress size.
We can arrange delivery and setup in {city}. Tell us your area when you ask for a price and we confirm the details.

faqs.q: Can I see examples of your work?
faqs.a: Our Facebook and Google pages are linked on this site. You can also ask on WhatsApp about pieces similar to the one you want.
